verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents only that it can "automate payment reminders", which covers the core of automated dunning emails. No evidence shows configurable multi-step sequences, branded reminder emails (branding is documented for invoice templates only), in-app banners, grace periods, or final-state rules such as cancel vs unpaid. Missing for 10: configurable multi-step dunning sequences, branded reminder email templates, in-app/portal banners, grace-period settings, final-state cancel vs unpaid rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: automate payment reminders with Zoho Invoice
